message.Title: Generally Available: Azure Monitor Health Models

Body.Content:
Azure Monitor Health Models is now Generally Available.  
You can now build a Azure Monitor Health Model that defines and operationalizes workload health as a first-class construct by aggregating signals across metrics, logs, and dependencies into a single, unified health state. It reduces alert noise, accelerating incident response, and improving reliability for your services.  

Learn more.
